objective: Define the canonical shared ingredient schema and taxonomy using ICF-01 reconciliation evidence while preserving MIB-12 crafting, MIB-13 economy, D17 live Asset and creature-authority boundaries.

completion_evidence.authoring_conformance_check: schema self-check plus two valid source-backed examples and five expected-invalid cases passed before repository commit

implemented_decisions: Canonical IDs are manually governed and immutable after publication; lexical normalization is candidate discovery only and never identity authority.
Primary ingredient IDs use ingredient:<slug>; reusable processed ingredient-like intermediates use lineage-bearing preparation:<slug>; finished outputs remain their owning content kind.
Canonical rarity, nature/origin classification, acquisition availability and MIB-13 market scarcity are separate dimensions.
Canonical rarity bands are common, uncommon, rare, exceptional, legendary and unique; source mappings retain exact source terms and semantics.
Alchemy Exotic maps to exceptional only because Alchemy explicitly uses Exotic as a rarity tier; Agriculture Exotic/Supernatural remain classification assertions unless separately reconciled.
Legacy price/value records are provenance-scoped source assertions; MIB-13 remains current price and market-scarcity authority.
Units are typed and conversions require explicit exact rational rules; generic legacy output units remain source-generic until ICF-13.
Quality and condition remain live D17 Asset overlays; definitions only declare rule references/sensitivities.
Creature-source fields require authored evidence and support explicit coverage gaps rather than invented anatomy or lore.
Substitution is an explicit typed relation and never changes canonical identity.
Fire Blossom/Fireblossom and Phoenix Feather/Phoenix Feathers are resolved as identity aliases only, without silently resolving unrelated source conflicts.
completion_gate: PASSED — provider-neutral canonical ingredient schema/taxonomy resolves all ICF-01 open decisions; source vocabularies/provenance are preserved; rarity/classification/availability/market scarcity are separated; stable identity/alias/unit/profile/overlay/substitution/lifecycle rules are defined; later plant/animal/magical/derived/recipe/harvest content can reuse the schema without a parallel live-state ledger; exact-head AIOC repository health passed before merge.
nonauthorization: ICF-03 content before ICF-02 completion — now released only by the separate ICF-03 selection checkpoint
